notes.title: Steam Summer Sale 2020
notes.content:
While you are stacking up on new games for the summer, you won't regret adding Zombie Scrapper to your shopping list at 60% off. That's just over a dollar for a 36 level campaign, 12 horde mode survival levels, and a ton of classic zombie killing weapons to enjoy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34741546/d1ddc24c9124995175b24eef17410f79a03945eb.png[/img]

If this game has been sitting on your wishlist for a while, now is the time to add it to your library!

notes.title: Zombie Scrapper Launch Party
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34741546/4d15f74bdee27db46c7a7c016b821d073c30d730.png[/img]
Hey there, Zombie Scrapper just released on Steam!

If you enjoy twin-stick action adventure games where hundreds of zombies attack you from all sides...then you come to the right place. Enjoy blasting them to smithereens using all sorts of weapons available in the game. 

For those of you who had this on your wish list, thank you! Get a head start on your weekend and pick this game up. We would love to hear your thoughts and experiences playing the game so please reach out on our community hub.

Good luck, have fun!

- CheMClarc
